chapters.summary: Paul gives thanks to God for the growth of the Thessalonian believers, and comforts them with the assurance that God will bring righteous judgment at Christ's return, giving rest to those who suffer affliction.
keyPoints: Paul and his fellow workers give thanks to God for the believers' faith, love, and patience, because they remain steadfast in the faith amid affliction.
God is a righteous judge, who will punish those who persecute believers when the Lord Jesus is revealed, and grant rest to those who suffer affliction.
Paul prays for the believers, that God would count them worthy of his calling and glorify them in Christ, so that the Lord's name may also be glorified through them.
chapters.application: In times of hardship, remember that God is righteous and that he watches over you. Endure with faith and love as you wait for the Lord's coming, for he will give you rest.

chapters.summary: Paul urges the Thessalonian believers not to be shaken by false reports, explaining that before the day of the Lord there must first come a falling away and the revealing of the son of perdition, and calls them to hold fast to the truth they have received.
keyPoints: Paul reminds the believers not to be alarmed by rumor or letter, for the day of the Lord has not yet come.
He explains that the man of sin, the son of perdition, will be revealed, but the Lord Jesus will destroy him with the brightness of his coming.
Paul urges the believers to stand fast and hold to the traditions handed down by the apostles.
chapters.application: In the face of every rumor about the last days, we need not be alarmed. Let us root ourselves in the truth of Scripture, stand firm in our faith, and wait for the Lord's return.

chapters.summary: Paul urges the believers to pray for the spread of the gospel, warns them to keep away from those who are idle and disorderly, and teaches them to respond to the Lord's word with good deeds and quiet, diligent work.
keyPoints: Paul asks the believers to pray for him and his fellow workers, that the word of the Lord may run swiftly and be glorified.
He warns the believers to withdraw from any brother who walks disorderly, lest they be led astray by him.
Paul urges the believers to follow his example, working quietly, earning their own bread, and not growing weary in doing good.
themes: Prayer and the Spread of the Gospel
chapters.application: Let us always pray for the work of the gospel, bear witness through quiet, diligent labor, keep ourselves from idleness, never grow weary in doing good, and live out the likeness of Christ.
